question: Should OpenClaw add first-class agent-scoped web/tool credential overrides, and should that contract live under `agents.list[].tools.web` or a more generic per-agent tool/plugin configuration surface?
rationale: The answer defines a credential isolation boundary across SecretRefs, plugin-owned webSearch config, provider auto-detection, config.apply, docs, reload, and upgrade behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design generic agent-scoped tool/plugin config
options.body: Add a shared contract for agent-scoped tool/provider/plugin settings with explicit precedence, SecretRef handling, validation, reload, docs, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Add only per-agent web settings
options.body: Solve the immediate web-search credential use case under `agents.list[].tools.web`, accepting a narrower surface that may later need reconciliation with plugin-owned webSearch configuration.

options.title: Keep web credentials global
options.body: Leave web-search provider credentials global or plugin-scoped and document separate gateways or provider-specific workarounds for billing isolation.

recommendation.title: Design generic agent-scoped tool/plugin config
recommendation.body: Add a shared contract for agent-scoped tool/provider/plugin settings with explicit precedence, SecretRef handling, validation, reload, docs, and upgrade tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a credential isolation and config-boundary decision, and steipete has recent adjacent SecretRef/config history.
